description.text: Objectives Objective of the undergraduate program in E-Commerce aims to enhance students’ ability in management, communication, E-Commerce system Planning, and Analysis and Design. The program includes subjects in the areas of management, trade, finance, marketing, computer network technology, modern business and management, law, trade principles, as well as Chinese trade relations with neighboring regions. Graduates from the program will have a good employment opportunity in companies and government agencies involved in trades with China. Duration Duration of the program is 4 years with course works in the first three years, followed by a thesis project and practice. Degree Awarded A bachelor degree in economics is awarded for students who meet the requirement for graduation. Main Courses Principles of Management, Principles of Economics, E-Commerce Database Technology, E-Commerce Development Technology, E-Commerce System Analysis and Design, E-Commerce Website Construction, Electronic Payment and Network Finance, E-Commerce Logistics Management, Network Marketing and Planning, E-Commerce Laws and Regulations.

duration.text: The E-Commerce at Harbin Institute of Technology(Shenzhen Campus) is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in English.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4166 USD/per year ￥ 30000 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1) A copy of passport (the original passport will be checked during registration) 2) One passport-size photo (35mm*50mm) 3) Graduation certificate of high schoolGraduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized.4) Academic transcript of high school

requirements.text: 1. Applicants must be non-Chinese citizens with a valid passport. 2. Be Healthy. 3. Under the age of 30 4. Have attained a senior high school diploma with good marks. 5. Have solid financial support to afford the study and living expense in China.6. Good English reading, writing and speaking skills.
